Study.Value: A randomized, open-label, single-dose, two-period, two-sequence (2x2) crossover bioequivalence study of SIMDRUG 100 mg tablets in healthy adults (synthetic)
Synthetic data only: simulated for a portfolio worked example; not real trial data and not a regulatory deliverable.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for TRTSEQP
Methods.Description: ADSL.TRTSEQP = DM.ARMCD (TR or RT, from the randomization schedule).

Methods.Name: Algorithm for TRTXXP
Methods.Description: TRT01P/TRT02P = first/second letter of TRTSEQP decoded (T = Test, R = Reference); TRTxxPN 1 = Test, 2 = Reference.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for TRTSDTM
Methods.Description: First (last) EX record with EXDOSE > 0: EXSTDTC (EXENDTC) converted with admiral::derive_vars_dtm(); date part by derive_vars_dtm_to_dt().

Methods.Name: Algorithm for TRTEDTM
Methods.Description: Last EX record with EXDOSE > 0, EXENDTC converted with admiral::derive_vars_dtm().

Methods.Name: Algorithm for APXX
Methods.Description: admiral::derive_vars_period() from a period reference dataset built from EX: period xx starts at its dose (EXSTDTM) and ends one minute before the next dose, or at 23:59:59 on the end-of-study date; TRTxxA from EXTRT.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for TRTSEQA
Methods.Description: First letters of TRT01A and TRT02A (T or R); one letter when only one period was dosed.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for EOSSTT
Methods.Description: From DS where DSCAT = DISPOSITION EVENT: COMPLETED if DSDECOD = COMPLETED, else DISCONTINUED; DCSREAS = DSDECOD when discontinued; EOSDT = DSSTDTC.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for VSBL
Methods.Description: VS.VSSTRESN at screening for VSTESTCD = HEIGHT (HEIGHTBL) and VSTESTCD = WEIGHT with VSBLFL = Y (WEIGHTBL).

Methods.Name: Algorithm for BMIBL
Methods.Description: admiral::compute_bmi(HEIGHTBL, WEIGHTBL), rounded to 1 decimal.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for RANDFL
Methods.Description: Y if DS has DSDECOD = RANDOMIZED, else N (admiral::derive_var_merged_exist_flag()).

Methods.Name: Algorithm for SAFFL
Methods.Description: Y if EX has a record with EXDOSE > 0, else N.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for PKCFL
Methods.Description: Y if SAFFL = Y and ADPC has a quantifiable post-dose concentration (ANL01FL = Y, AVAL > 0, ARRLT > 0).

Methods.Name: Algorithm for PKPFL
Methods.Description: Y if PKCFL = Y and ADPP has at least one period with ANL01FL = Y.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for BEFL
Methods.Description: Y if PKPFL = Y and ADPP has ANL01FL = Y periods for both Test and Reference (ICH M13A: evaluable data for both products).

Methods.Name: Algorithm for APERIOD.PC
Methods.Description: Period of the reference dose (PCRFTDTM); a pre-dose sample belongs to the dose that follows it.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for TRTA.PC
Methods.Description: TRT01A or TRT02A for the record's APERIOD.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for PARAMCD.PC
Methods.Description: PC.PCTESTCD for concentration records; DOSE for the dose records kept from EX (admiral ad_adpc.R).

Methods.Name: Algorithm for AVAL.PC
Methods.Description: PC.PCSTRESN; BLQ results (PCSTRESC = <BLQ) set to 0 with BLQFL = Y (SAP, ICH M13A); EX.EXDOSE for dose records.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for AVALCAT1.PC
Methods.Description: BLQ for BLQ results, else AVAL to 3 significant digits.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ABLFL.PC
Methods.Description: Y for the pre-dose record of each period when AVAL is not missing.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ANL01FL.PC
Methods.Description: Y for concentration records with AVAL and ARRLT not missing (all collected samples; NCA input).

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ANL02FL.PC
Methods.Description: Y when ANL01FL = Y and the period is not excluded (ADPP.PKEXRSN missing): concentration summaries and mean plots.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ADTM.PC
Methods.Description: admiral::derive_vars_dtm() of PCDTC (dose records: EXSTDTC); ADT and ATM from ADTM.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ADY
Methods.Description: admiral::derive_vars_dy() with reference date TRTSDT.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for FANLDTM
Methods.Description: First dose datetime for the analyte (admiral ad_adpc.R).

Methods.Name: Algorithm for PCRFTDTM
Methods.Description: Datetime of the reference dose: the previous dose, or the next dose for a pre-dose sample.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for AFRLT
Methods.Description: admiral::derive_vars_duration() from FANLDTM to ADTM, hours.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for NFRLT
Methods.Description: admiral::derive_var_nfrlt() (EXPERIMENTAL in admiral 1.5.0): (VISITDY - 1) x 24 + PCTPT in hours.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ARRLT
Methods.Description: admiral::derive_vars_duration() from the reference dose to ADTM, hours; negative for a pre-dose sample.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for NRRLT
Methods.Description: NFRLT minus the nominal time of the reference dose.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ATPT.PC
Methods.Description: PC.PCTPT and PCTPTNUM; Dose for dose records; ATPTREF = Period n Dose; BASETYPE = ATPTREF + Baseline.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for DOSEA
Methods.Description: EXDOSE of the reference dose.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for AVISIT.PC
Methods.Description: Day (NFRLT %/% 24 + 1), as in admiral ad_adpc.R.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ASEQ
Methods.Description: admiral::derive_var_obs_number() within USUBJID.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for APERIOD.PP
Methods.Description: PP.VISITNUM (the period of the NCA profile).

Methods.Name: Algorithm for TRTA.PP
Methods.Description: TRTxxP/TRTxxA of APERIOD (crossover adaptation of admiral ad_adpp.R).

Methods.Name: Algorithm for PARAMCD.PP
Methods.Description: PP.PPTESTCD through the parameter lookup table.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ANL01FL.PP
Methods.Description: Y when Cmax and AUC(0-t) exist for the period and PKEXRSN is missing: descriptive PK summaries.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ANL02FL.PP
Methods.Description: Y when ANL01FL = Y and the participant has ANL01FL = Y periods for both products: bioequivalence analysis.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for PKEXRSN
Methods.Description: SAP exclusion rules in order: emesis within 2 h of dosing (ADAE); pre-dose concentration above 5% of the period's Cmax; AUC(0-t) below 5% of the product's geometric mean AUC without the participant (ICH M13A).

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ADT.PP
Methods.Description: admiral::derive_vars_dt() of PP.PPRFTDTC.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for AVISIT.PP
Methods.Description: Day ADY, as in admiral ad_adpp.R.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for APERIOD.AE
Methods.Description: admiral::create_period_dataset() + derive_vars_joined(): the period whose start and end datetimes contain ASTDTM; TRTA from that period.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ASEVN
Methods.Description: 1 = MILD, 2 = MODERATE, 3 = SEVERE.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for ASTDTM
Methods.Description: admiral::derive_vars_dtm() of AESTDTC, highest imputation month, time imputed to the first.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for AENDTM
Methods.Description: admiral::derive_vars_dtm() of AEENDTC, highest imputation month, time imputed to the last.

Methods.Name: Algorithm for TRTEMFL
Methods.Description: admiral::derive_var_trtemfl(): onset on or after TRTSDTM.

Comments.Description: Synthetic data only: simulated for a portfolio worked example; not real trial data and not a regulatory deliverable.
